S24.04.needs: a Free or paid AGI Cloud account; at least one artifact made by a chat (for the open step)
S24.04.note: The quick pick is the list view; the sidebar tree view for artifacts is not registered in package.json, so there is no separate Explorer panel. Code path for listing and opening: artifactsTree.ts getChildren and the agi-workforce.openArtifact command (commandSetup.ts). "Code: Show Artifacts" is the palette entry; "Code: Open Artifact" is hidden from the palette (when: false). Note: the Artifacts menu item label comes from surfaceMenu.ts, not a translation file, and the empty/sign-in texts are in artifactsTree.ts. Plan's "Where to find it" was blank, so this path is derived from code only.
steps: Sign in to AGI Cloud (the Artifacts view needs an AGI Cloud account).
Open the AGI Workforce chat panel in the editor sidebar and click the "More" button (aria-label "More actions").
Click "Artifacts" in the menu. A quick pick titled "Code, Artifacts" opens, with the placeholder "Open an artifact…".
Look for the artifacts list. Each row is an artifact title; with a signed-out account you see "Sign in to see your artifacts" instead, and with none you see "No artifacts yet".
Click (or press Enter on) an artifact row. It opens read-only in an editor tab, which compares with Expected: the artifact opens.
S24.04.where: Chat panel > More actions ("More" button) > Artifacts; or Command Palette > "Code: Show Artifacts"
